swap.Tower One: the glass tower seen from bel: Casa Moreira: the project from outside
swap.A glass tower for Atelier Sul, shot on e: A spiral stair in a Porto townhouse, shot in one long afternoon.
swap.Three weeks for the right grey day: One stair, one afternoon, one window
swap.Atelier Sul wanted Tower One shown as it: The whole house turns around a white spiral stair under a round skylight. The architects asked for the stair alone, so I spent an afternoon on it, moving down a step at a time as the sun came round, and made four photos from two hundred.
swap.Ines shot our tower over three weeks and: She notices the things we spent months on: a handrail, a shadow, a join in the stone.

swap.A glass tower for Atelier Sul, shot on e: Social housing in Setúbal, photographed with the families who live there.
swap.Three weeks for the right grey day: A blue building and the people in it
swap.Atelier Sul wanted Tower One shown as it: Habitar Setúbal wanted photos of their new homes for a funding report, with the tenants in them. I spent two days in the building, mostly drinking coffee in kitchens, and photographed people where they felt most at home.
swap.Ines shot our tower over three weeks and: The people in her photos make the buildings feel lived in. Our tenants loved seeing themselves.

swap.Tower One: the glass tower seen from bel: Marvila studios: the project from outside
swap.A glass tower for Atelier Sul, shot on e: Artists' studios in an old warehouse, just down the road from mine.
swap.Three weeks for the right grey day: White on white, in the hardest light
swap.Atelier Sul wanted Tower One shown as it: Studio Ferro turned a riverside warehouse into twelve studios with white concrete stairs and walls. White is the hardest thing to photograph, so we waited for a hazy morning, when the shadows were soft but still there.
swap.Ines shot our tower over three weeks and: She printed one for our office and it's the first thing visitors ask about.

swap.Tower One: the glass tower seen from bel: Mercado Novo: the project from outside
swap.A glass tower for Atelier Sul, shot on e: A market hall brought back to life, on opening day and the week after.
swap.Three weeks for the right grey day: Opening day, and an ordinary Tuesday
swap.Atelier Sul wanted Tower One shown as it: The council restored a nineteenth-century market hall and asked for photos of the opening. I said yes, and asked to come back on an ordinary Tuesday too. The Tuesday photos are the ones they still use.
swap.Ines shot our tower over three weeks and: We still use her photos of the market hall, four years on.
